killedBy: enemy role cues: the mapping is the number the player needs orders the hull lever by the same budget, on the axis that can carry three states
why: Moves the STANDARD shell's hull off the shipped corner radius, from HULL_CORNER to 0.35. The ordering still holds -- 0.16 < 0.35 < 0.45 -- so an ordering-only check passes, and the board still looks plausible. What breaks is the property every arm of issue #357 rests on: the standard shell is the shipped tank, so pulling this lever must leave a normal-shell tank vertex-identical and move only the other two states. Under the mutation the lever silently restyles every tank carrying the default weapon, which is most of the roster, and the comparison would be measuring a different tank than the one it claims. Pinned against HULL_CORNER itself rather than a literal, so retuning the shipped hull moves the assertion with it.
